description: GITM simulates the coupled thermosphere and ionosphere on an altitude-based spherical grid. It resolves vertical momentum and multiple neutral and ion species to study dynamics that hydrostatic formulations can miss. The resource is documented by CSEM. The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere, Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Its upper-altitude limit and incomplete plasmasphere representation can affect total-electron-content estimates. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue.
